explicitExclusions.reason: Third-party installed dependency bodies; manifests and lockfiles were reviewed, but online advisory lookup was not part of this offline source scan.
Generated build artifacts and packaged copies; authoritative source and packaging configuration were reviewed.
Generated Tauri schemas; capability configuration was reviewed instead.
Binary visual-regression and icon assets contain no executable application logic.
Prior generated security reports are outputs, not current product source.

surfaces.label: Audio import, header checks, WebAudio decoding, and browser transcription
surfaces.notes: Validated bounded compressed input but insufficient decoded-memory/work budgeting.
surfaces.riskArea: Untrusted media parsing and resource use

surfaces.label: Tauri IPC and optional Basic Pitch Python analysis
surfaces.notes: Shell injection and unbounded pipe capture were rejected; remaining low-risk boundary issues are reported.
surfaces.riskArea: Native path authorization, process concurrency, and analyzer resource limits

surfaces.label: Microphone permission, MediaRecorder lifecycle, timeout, and teardown
surfaces.notes: Single-recorder cleanup is effective; concurrent pending acquisitions are not.

surfaces.label: Cross-workspace analysis ownership and result commits
surfaces.notes: Component remount resets the in-flight guard and permits stale commits.

surfaces.label: Zustand persistence, SQLite commands, and analysis export
surfaces.notes: SQL injection and prototype pollution were rejected; exported absolute paths remain a privacy issue.

surfaces.label: React rendering, CSP, remote origins, and script sinks
surfaces.notes: No HTML/code-evaluation sink or remote application origin was found; production CSP restricts scripts to self.

surfaces.label: Dialog and filesystem plugin capabilities
surfaces.notes: Normal file reads follow dialog selection and the capability is limited to the local main window; custom IPC authorization is covered separately.
